Plot survey estimates

Source: R/plot.R
plot.bdhs_estimate.Rd

Point-and-interval plot of the estimates returned by bdhs_estimate(): one panel per indicator, one row per group (when by was used), and one colour per survey round when several rounds are present. Intervals are the confidence intervals of the estimates (at the level used by bdhs_estimate()).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bdhs_estimate'
plot(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'bdhs_estimate'
autoplot(object, ...)

Arguments

x, object

A bdhs_estimate tibble from bdhs_estimate().

...

Unused.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

est <- tibble::tibble(
  survey_id = "BD2022DHS", indicator = "anc4", label = "ANC 4+ visits",
  v025 = c("urban", "rural"), estimate = c(54.1, 37.9), se = c(2.1, 1.4),
  ci_low = c(50, 35.2), ci_high = c(58.2, 40.6), n_unweighted = c(1200L, 3400L),
  n_weighted = c(1250, 3350), api_id = "RH_ANCN_W_N4P"
)
class(est) <- c("bdhs_estimate", class(est))
plot(est)
